_comment: 🧩️ Host wiring for this artifact's cases. The (non-)oracle registration and the mutation catalogue belong to the SUBSET that owns the vocabulary and live in 🏅️standards/🔖️1/🪆️subsets/✳️any/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json; this file exists only because a case sits at the artifact root and the generated Rust host resolves its contributed crates from the CASE OWNER. The single crate named here is linked for its domain-neutral `law` module alone — `⚖️law/🦀️component.rs` is dependency-free and format-neutral by its own doc comment, and the `oracles` feature that would pull in the third-party reference libraries is deliberately NOT enabled, so nothing outside this repository is linked into this artifact's test host.
